description: Builds a jet lag plan from the home and destination time zones, the flight’s local departure and arrival times and the traveller’s usual sleep. Returns the body-clock shift needed, the direction (advance or delay), and for each day before departure, the travel day and the days after arrival: a sleep window, light to seek, light to avoid and an optional caffeine cut-off. Based on published circadian research; general guidance, not medical advice. Web page: https://globalluxagency.com/tools/jet-lag-planner

arrival.description: Arrival, local time at the destination, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM.

departure.description: Departure, local time at home, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM.

destinationTimeZone.description: IANA time zone at the destination, e.g. Asia/Dubai.

homeTimeZone.description: IANA time zone at home, e.g. Europe/London.

preflightDays.description: Days before departure to start shifting sleep (0 = none; 2–3 suggested).

strategy.description: Shift the body clock earlier (advance), later (delay), or let the planner choose (auto).

wakeTime.description: Usual wake time at home, HH:MM (24-hour).

name: jet-lag-planner
title: Jet Lag Planner
